== Acquisition ==
This skill is given to Ritualists competing in a [[Dwayna Vs Grenth]] match, as well as in [[Wintersday]] quests.

== Notes ==

* This skill is only available to players during [[Wintersday]] events. It is also used by [[Industrious Snowman|Industrious Snowmen]] in the [[Secret Lair of the Snowmen]].
* Jack Frost is unique among binding rituals in that the summoned spirit is vulnerable to [[hex]]es and uses a spell instead a [[ranged attack]].
** Since its attacks are spell-based; they have [[range#spell range|spell range]], are not affected by height, and cannot be [[block]]ed.
* Since [[Yuletide]] sets all primary attributes to 0, it cannot be affected by [[Spawning Power]].

== Trivia ==
* The name of this skill comes from the folklore figure [[w:Jack Frost|Jack Frost]].
